items.title: Albert Nicholas Interview, 1972-06-26
items.q: I was moving, Lloyd Russell. I said, wait a minute. Jelly's got a band... I came with Lloyd, came in the band, and Lloyd said, oh, man, come on back to the band.

ctx.x: So the man hadn't heard the band. You know, you just tell them. Nine o'clock, we hit. Everybody's in show uniform, short. Plenty of people out. Nobody come in. Nobody come. They're waiting to hear. Yeah. And so Jelly said, listen, don't tell them what band is. You know, just anybody ask you what band is. My band, you know. Don't see no Lloyd Russell or nothing like that. You know, it's probably. He said, yeah, okay, he got you covered. Man, we hit band. Jelly was directing. We played our arrangement. You know,…
So, New York. Is this Jelly's band? Yeah.
